cases.name: Gabriele Seitz
cases.about: "She was the sweetest person alive that everyone loved," said Justin Omans, Seitz's eldest son. "She made people laugh... she liked to dance, sing, everything.” “She was just a perfect mother, a perfect friend, a perfect sister to everyone that know her,” Omans said.
cases.narrative: On 10/27/2022, her body was found in his truck after a vehicle accident. She had "obvious signs of strangulation," including a shoelace tied around her neck.
